message.content:
The quadratic equation \(3x^{2}-2x-5=0\) has two real roots:

\[
x=\frac{2\pm\sqrt{(-2)^{2}-4(3)(-5)}}{2(3)}
   =\frac{2\pm\sqrt{4+60}}{6}
   =\frac{2\pm\sqrt{64}}{6}
   =\frac{2\pm 8}{6}.
\]

Thus,

\[
x_{1}=\frac{2+8}{6}=\frac{10}{6}=\frac{5}{3}\approx 1.667,
\qquad
x_{2}=\frac{2-8}{6}=\frac{-6}{6}=-1.
\]

So the roots are \(\boxed{x=\frac{5}{3}}\) and \(\boxed{x=-1}\).
